card.name: Inside rare names and new drug names
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of rare proper names and newly coined drug names, just before the final piece. Typical cases are surnames like Karhadkar and drug names ending in -stat or -inib.

modes.label: Rare surnames
modes.description: Partway through uncommon personal names of authors or researchers, often Indian or Italian in origin.

modes.example: Sebetral<<stat>> is a substrate of CYP3A
